title: Evaluate individual feature additions, combinations and ablations on human feedback
description: Agreed 2026-10-05 feature-engineering evaluation plan. Depends on core feature-bank/single-feature API tracked by Decision-Flywheel issue 1baadb68-9f35-432c-a900-8e2d9f8e7d44. Before live collection freeze a text-free protocol: training/development/audit roles, feedback cutoff, per-class counts, frozen incumbent rubric and examples, provider/model, question versions, weighting, fitting procedure, primary development metric and explicit request/trial ceilings. Start by comparing one additional question at a time against the same incumbent; later run budgeted pairs/groups and removal ablations. Report training probability separation as descriptive evidence, not generalization. Measure incremental development improvement, coverage, redundancy and interactions; retain unsuccessful concepts and wording variants for later feedback cutoffs. Distinguish feature exploration from classifier deployment; a losing bundled classifier does not invalidate each factor. Keep optimizer blind to development/audit labels and errors. Do not tune or choose experiments using sealed scoreboard results. Publish counts, trial ledger, usage, uncertainty and retrospective limitations without private article text, feedback comments or secrets. First milestone is a reproducible single-feature experiment using the reusable core, not a second flywheel implementation. No live calls authorized by creating this issue. No DSPy.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Core single-feature milestone is implemented and verified with 427 offline specs. Each proposed supporting question is now admitted independently, fitted against a common incumbent with other questions/rubric/examples fixed, and retained with training-signal diagnostics and development results. Individual-feature experiment preflight on the frozen 87-vote snapshot permits up to five isolated fits, with ceiling 373 Jev / 3 GPT-6 Luna calls; one-feature limit permits three fits and ceiling 227 / 3. No new paid calls or new performance result yet. Existing grouped-question experiment is historical evidence only. Next evaluation must freeze the new protocol and collect individual trials without leaking protected feedback. Combinations and ablations remain deferred until this path is validated live.

comments.author: home
comments.text: First real individual-question comparison completed and documented in studies/arxiv_feature_engineering/README.md. Same frozen 65 training (4 Include), 4 development, 4 reused audit labels; independent trials against empty incumbent, equal-class fit/evaluation weighting. Memory systems and research-literature question individually improved development Brier (0.4548 and 0.5025 versus 0.5691); examples-only 0.4052 selected. Knowledge clarification/curation 0.8212 retained despite losing. All five trial comparisons present after diagnostic-rounding recovery reused cached training answers and added four development calls; original failure preserved. Total 357 Jev and 3 GPT-6 Luna requests, below approved 373/3. Returned Jev tokens input 443831/output 19623; Luna prompt 68094/completion 1821. Audit selected policy 4/4 versus 1/4 baseline is explicitly small and reused, not a general accuracy claim. No live reviewer replacement. Individual milestone complete; combinations/ablations and broader evidence remain pending, so story stays in progress. Protected errors did not steer proposals.
